limitations: New C++ interface differs from native caller ABI; no game, reset or rendering validation.
Explicit after-real-provider observers mutate actual renderer/device/table/cache/mode/locks; no provider result substitution.
Raw renderer storage and full actual CS bytes compare literally in same-process pairs; device side effects observed through all32 real GetStreamSourceFreq values.
Selected stream10000000 has wrapped arithmetic with valid fixture storage and was accepted by this actual runtime; not a general validity claim for other out-of-range device streams.
Cleanup second-throw cases run in separate isolated processes with std::terminate handler terminating via ExitProcess73 after actual Leave; they do not return normally.
No malformed/uninitialized saved guard is read by flipping entry-disabled mode to enabled.
